description: Free. Opens your own vault for the tokenized US stock basket (NVDA, META, AAPL, GOOGL), controlled only by you. Returns an UNSIGNED transaction {to, data, value, chainId} on Base; nothing happens until you sign it with your own wallet and broadcast it. Liquid never holds keys or funds. After it confirms, find the vault with stocks_portfolio.
